get.description: Retrieves the form definitions of the tenant, with optional name search. Requires the form-service admin role (`urn:ads:platform:form-service:form-admin`) in the tenant; core users are not accepted, and anonymous requests respond 403.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Number of definitions to return in a page. Passed to the configuration service, which accepts 1 to 1000.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor for retrieving additional pages.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Search for form definitions by name (partial match, case-insensitive).

parameters.name: createDateAfter
parameters.description: Only include definitions created on or after this date (ISO-8601).

parameters.name: createDateBefore
parameters.description: Only include definitions created on or before this date (ISO-8601).

post.description:
Creates a new form definition in the tenant. Requires the form-service admin role
(`urn:ads:platform:form-service:form-admin`). Core users with the role must set `tenantId`.

Only `name` and `description` are accepted in the request body. All other fields are set automatically:
- `id`: auto-generated from `name` in kebab-case
- `anonymousApply`: `false`
- `applicantRoles`, `assessorRoles`, and `clerkRoles`: `[]`
- `securityClassification`: `protected b`

400.description: Validation failed, the ID could not be generated from the provided name, or the configuration service rejected the definition.

example.errorMessage: Form definition ID could not be generated from the provided name.

409.description: Form definition with the generated ID already exists.

example.errorMessage: Form definition with ID 'business-licence-application' already exists.

get.description:
Retrieves a form definition, with its current scheduled intake if it uses scheduled intakes. Requires the form-service admin or intake-application role, or one of the definition's applicant or clerk roles, in the tenant of the definition.

If the definition allows anonymous applications, any user can read it and the request does not need a bearer token. Anonymous requests have no token to determine the tenant from, so they must include the tenantId query parameter.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Revision of the form definition to retrieve. Defaults to the active revision.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: ID of the tenant of the definition. Required for anonymous requests and core users; ignored for tenant users.

400.description: Request is invalid, or the tenant cannot be determined for an anonymous request.

example.errorMessage: Cannot determine tenant context of request.

patch.description: Partially updates an existing form definition. Requires the form-service admin role (`urn:ads:platform:form-service:form-admin`); core users with the role must set `tenantId`. Only the provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left unchanged.

put.description: Replaces a form definition with the request body, creating it if it does not exist. Requires the form-service admin role (`urn:ads:platform:form-service:form-admin`); core users with the role must set `tenantId`. The `id` of the definition is taken from the path.

example.name: Business licence application
example.description: Application for a municipal business licence.

delete.description: Deletes a form definition. Requires the form-service admin role (`urn:ads:platform:form-service:form-admin`); core users with the role must set `tenantId`. Deleting a definition that does not exist also responds 204.

patch.description: Partially updates the lifecycle settings of an existing form definition. Requires the form-service admin role (`urn:ads:platform:form-service:form-admin`); core users with the role must set `tenantId`. Only provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left unchanged.

allowAnonymousApplication.description: Whether anonymous (unauthenticated) applicants can submit the form.

allowMultipleFormsPerApplicant.description: Whether an applicant can submit more than one form. When false, only one form per applicant is allowed.

createSupportTopic.description: Whether a support topic is created for each new form.

securityClassification.description: Security classification of the form definition.

put.description: Replaces the applicant, assessor, and clerk roles of an existing form definition. Requires the form-service admin role (`urn:ads:platform:form-service:form-admin`); core users with the role must set `tenantId`. The provided roles replace the existing roles entirely; any role array omitted from the request is reset to empty.

applicantRoles.description: Roles permitted to apply. Replaces the existing applicant roles entirely.

assessorRoles.description: Roles permitted to assess submissions. Replaces the existing assessor roles entirely.

clerkRoles.description: Roles permitted to act as clerks. Replaces the existing clerk roles entirely.

put.description: Updates the scheduled intake period of a form definition, by updating its event in the calendar service. Requires the form-service admin role (`urn:ads:platform:form-service:form-admin`); core users with the role must set `tenantId`. Responds with the form definition and its updated intake. A definition that does not exist responds 400.

400.description: Request is invalid, or the form definition does not exist.

put.description: Updates the data and UI schemas for an existing form definition. Requires the form-service admin role (`urn:ads:platform:form-service:form-admin`); core users with the role must set `tenantId`.

data-schema.description: JSON Schema describing the shape of the form data. If omitted, the existing data schema is preserved.

ui-schema.description: UI schema describing the layout and controls of the form. If omitted, the existing UI schema is preserved.

204.description: Schemas updated successfully. No content is returned.

patch.description: Partially updates the actions invoked when a form is submitted. Requires the form-service admin role (`urn:ads:platform:form-service:form-admin`); core users with the role must set `tenantId`. Only provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left unchanged. Properties other than those listed respond 400.

createPDF.description: Whether to generate a submission PDF using the default submitted-form template.

createSubmissionRecords.description: Whether to create submission records when the form is submitted.

event.description: Custom submission event in namespace:name format. Set to null to clear.

includeDataInEvent.description: Whether submitted form data is included in the submission event payload.

taskQueue.description: Queue task target in queueNameSpace:queueName format. Set to null to clear.

get.description: Find forms. Users with the form-service admin role, or the export-service export-job role, can find all forms of the tenant. When the criteria include definitionIdEquals, users with one of that definition's assessor roles can find its submitted forms. Other users only find the forms they created, and cannot use includeData. Core users must set `tenantId`.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Number of forms to return in a page. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: includeData
parameters.description: Flag indicating if form data should be included in results.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor for retrieving additional pages.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description:
Column to sort results on. Use 'created' or 'status' for form fields, and 'data.' followed by
the path into the form data for a data value (e.g. 'data.applicant.lastName').

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Direction of the sort. Defaults to descending.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: Criteria for the forms to retrieve, as JSON. Date values must be ISO-8601 strings.

dataCriteria.description: Values to match in the form data, keyed by the path into the data (e.g. 'applicant.lastName'). Text values are case-insensitive partial matches.

post.description:
Creates a draft form of a definition in the tenant, optionally with data, and optionally submits it straight away. Requires one of the definition's applicant or clerk roles; if the definition allows anonymous applications, the form-service intake-application role is also accepted. When the definition uses scheduled intakes, forms can only be created during an active intake, unless the user has the form-service form-tester role or the request is a dry run.

An applicant who creates their own form is set as the form's applicant (and notified by email) when applicant information is included or the definition allows one form per applicant. Clerks and intake applications can provide the details of the applicant they act for.

id.description: ID of an existing notification service subscriber to use as the applicant.

data.description: Initial form data. File references can be embedded as file-service URNs.

files.description: Not used; file references are resolved from the data.

submit.description: Submit the form immediately after it is created.

dryRun.description: Validate and simulate the request without saving the form.

anonymousApplicant.summary: Intake application creates a draft for an anonymous applicant

400.description: Request is invalid, the definition has no active intake, or the data is not valid for the definition when the form is submitted.

example.errorMessage: Cannot create form as there is no active intake.

get.description: Retrieves a form, and its submission if it is submitted. Requires the form-service admin or intake-application role, one of the definition's clerk or assessor roles, or one of its applicant roles for the form's creator (unless the form is archived). Including the data needs the form data access described for `GET /form/v1/forms/{formId}/data`, and fails for locked forms. Core users must set `tenantId`.

parameters.name: includeData
parameters.description: Flag indicating if data should be included in results.

post.description:
Executes a form operation. The user must be able to read the form (see `GET /form/v1/forms/{formId}`), and
each operation needs a further role:
- `send-code`: the form-service intake-application role. Sends a verification code to the applicant.
- `unlock`: the form-service admin role. Only locked forms can be unlocked.
- `submit`: one of the definition's clerk roles, or an applicant role for the form's creator. Only draft forms
  can be submitted, and the data must be valid for the definition's data schema.
- `to-draft`: the form-service admin role or one of the definition's assessor roles. Only submitted forms can be
  set back to draft.
- `archive`: the form-service admin role.

Core users must set `tenantId`.

sendCode.summary: Send a verification code to the applicant

toDraft.summary: Set a submitted form back to draft

400.description: Request is invalid, the form is not in a status that allows the operation, or the data is not valid for the definition on submit.

example.errorMessage: Cannot submit form not in draft.

delete.description: Deletes a form and its files. Requires the form-service admin role. Draft forms can also be deleted by users with one of the definition's clerk roles, and by their creator with one of the definition's applicant roles. The user must also be able to read the form (see `GET /form/v1/forms/{formId}`). Core users must set `tenantId`.

get.description: Retrieves form data. Requires the form-service admin role, one of the definition's applicant roles for the form's creator, one of its clerk roles while the form is a draft, or one of its assessor roles once it is submitted. Alternatively, a user with the form-service intake-application role can provide the verification code sent to the applicant. Locked forms cannot be read. Core users must set `tenantId`.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Verification code sent to the applicant with the send-code operation.

400.description: Request is invalid, or the form is locked.

401.description: Request does not include a valid bearer token, or the provided code could not be verified.

example.errorMessage: Provided code could not be verified.

put.description: Sets the form data of a draft form. Requires one of the definition's clerk roles, or one of its applicant roles for the form's creator. Files that are no longer referenced in the data are deleted. Core users must set `tenantId`.

data.description: Form data. File references can be embedded directly as file-service URNs anywhere in this object.

400.description: Request is invalid, or the form is not a draft.

example.errorMessage: Cannot update form not in draft.

get.description:
Retrieves submissions of a specified form matching search criteria. Requires the form-service admin role,
one of the form definition's assessor roles, or the export-service export-job role. Core users must set
`tenantId`.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Number of submissions to return in a page. Defaults to 100.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor for retrieving additional pages.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description:
Column to sort results on. Use 'created', 'submissionStatus', or 'disposition' for submission
fields, and 'data.' followed by the path into the form data for a data value
(e.g. 'data.applicant.lastName').

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Direction of the sort. Defaults to descending.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: Criteria for form submissions to retrieve, as JSON. Date values must be ISO-8601 strings.

createDateBefore.description: The form submission create date that it was created before.

createDateAfter.description: The form submission create date that it was created after.

dispositionStatusEquals.description: The disposition status for the form submission.

dispositionDateBefore.description: The disposition before date for the form submission was updated.

dispositionDateAfter.description: The disposition after date for the form submission was updated

createdByIdEquals.description: Name of the user the form submission was created by.

definitionIdEquals.description: ID of the form definition of the submissions.

submissionStatusEquals.description: The status of the form submission.

dispositioned.description: True to only include submissions with a disposition; false to only include submissions without one.

dataCriteria.description: Values to match in the submission data, keyed by the path into the data (e.g. 'applicant.lastName'). Text values are case-insensitive partial matches.

get.description: Retrieves a form submission. Requires the form-service admin role or one of the definition's assessor roles. Core users must set `tenantId`.

post.description: Update the form disposition for the form submission. Requires the form-service admin role or one of the definition's assessor roles. The status must match the ID or name of one of the definition's disposition states. Core users must set `tenantId`.
Adds a reviewer note to the form submission. Requires the form-service admin role or one of the definition's assessor roles. Core users must set `tenantId`.

example.content: Called applicant to confirm their mailing address.

200.description: Successfully added the note to the form submission.

parameters.name: noteId
parameters.description: ID of the note.

delete.description: Removes a reviewer note from the form submission. Requires the form-service admin role or one of the definition's assessor roles. Core users must set `tenantId`.

200.description: Successfully removed the note from the form submission.

get.description: Retrieves the data registers that have both a definition and a data document, i.e. the registers manageable through this API. Requires the form-service admin role or the configuration-service configuration-admin role. Core users with either role must set `tenantId`.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of data registers.

400.description: Request has no tenant context. A core user must specify the tenantId query parameter.

403.description: User is not authorized. Requires the form-service admin or configuration-admin role.

post.description: Creates a new data register: its definition in the shared platform/configuration-service document, followed by its entries in a data-register/<name> configuration document. Requires the form-service admin role or the configuration-service configuration-admin role. Core users with either role must set `tenantId`.

400.description: Request is not valid or has no tenant context, or configuration-service rejected the request.

403.description: User is not authorized. Requires the form-service admin or configuration-admin role.

409.description: A data register with this name already exists.

get.description: Retrieves a data register by name. Requires the form-service admin role or the configuration-service configuration-admin role. Core users with either role must set `tenantId`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the data register.

400.description: Name is not valid, or the request has no tenant context.

403.description: User is not authorized. Requires the form-service admin or configuration-admin role.

404.description: No data register with this name was found; it must have both a definition and a data document to be considered to exist.

patch.description: Updates the description and/or entries of an existing data register. Only provided fields are changed: sending description alone leaves the entries unchanged, and vice versa. Entries are written to the latest revision; if an older revision is pinned as active, the pin moves to that revision so the new entries are live. Requires the form-service admin role or the configuration-service configuration-admin role. Core users with either role must set `tenantId`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the data register.

400.description: Request is not valid or has no tenant context, or configuration-service rejected the request.

403.description: User is not authorized. Requires the form-service admin or configuration-admin role.

404.description: No data register with this name was found.

delete.description: Deletes a data register: its entries and its definition. Removes whichever of the two parts still exists, so a retry after a partial failure succeeds. Forms that reference the register in a dropdown or list will lose its options. Requires the form-service admin role or the configuration-service configuration-admin role. Core users with either role must set `tenantId`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the data register to delete.

400.description: Name is not valid, or the request has no tenant context.

403.description: User is not authorized. Requires the form-service admin or configuration-admin role.

404.description: No data register with this name was found; neither a definition nor a data document exists.

get.description:
Retrieves submissions of the tenant matching search criteria. Requires the form-service admin role or the
export-service export-job role. Users with one of a definition's assessor roles can retrieve its submissions by
including definitionIdEquals in the criteria. Core users must set `tenantId`.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Number of submissions to return in a page. Defaults to 100.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor for retrieving additional pages.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description:
Column to sort results on. Use 'created', 'submissionStatus', or 'disposition' for submission
fields, and 'data.' followed by the path into the form data for a data value
(e.g. 'data.applicant.lastName').

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Direction of the sort. Defaults to descending.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: Criteria for form submissions to retrieve, as JSON. Date values must be ISO-8601 strings.

createDateBefore.description: The form submission create date that it was created before.

createDateAfter.description: The form submission create date that it was created after.

dispositionStatusEquals.description: The disposition status for the form submission.

dispositionDateBefore.description: The disposition before date for the form submission was updated.

dispositionDateAfter.description: The disposition after date for the form submission was updated

createdByIdEquals.description: Name of the user the form submission was created by.

definitionIdEquals.description: ID of the form definition of the submissions.

submissionStatusEquals.description: The status of the form submission.

dispositioned.description: True to only include submissions with a disposition; false to only include submissions without one.

dataCriteria.description: Values to match in the submission data, keyed by the path into the data (e.g. 'applicant.lastName'). Text values are case-insensitive partial matches.

get.description: Retrieves a form submission. Requires the form-service admin role or one of the definition's assessor roles. Core users must set `tenantId`.

delete.description: Deletes a form submission. Requires the form-service admin role. Core users must set `tenantId`. A submission that does not exist responds 200 with `deleted: false`.

200.description: Successfully deleted the form submission, or no submission was found.

FormTenantId.name: tenantId
FormTenantId.description: ID of the tenant to act on. Required for core (platform) users. Tenant users always act on the tenant of their token, and this parameter is ignored for them.

FormBadRequest.description: Request is invalid, for example a path, query, or body parameter failed validation.

example.errorMessage: Validation failed with error(s): formId (params) - Invalid value
form definition with ID 'business-licence-application' could not be found.

FormForbidden.description: User does not have the role required for the operation.

example.errorMessage: User Test User (ID: 1234) not permitted to find submissions.

FormNotFound.description: Form definition, form, or submission not found. Forms and submissions of another tenant also respond 404.

example.errorMessage: Form submission with ID '5f1e2d3c-4b5a-4f6e-8d7c-9b0a1c2d3e4f' could not be found.

FormUnauthorized.description: Request does not include a valid bearer token.

namespace.description: Namespace of the data register. Always data-register.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the register contains.

entries.description: List of values stored in the register, from its active revision, or its latest revision if none is active.

name.description: Name of the data register. Unique within the tenant. 1 to 50 letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens and underscores, not starting or ending with a space.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the register contains.

entries.description: Initial list of values stored in the register. Defaults to an empty array.

DataRegisterUpdate.description: Partial update payload for a data register. Only provided fields are changed; omitting entries leaves the existing entries unchanged.

entries.description: Replacement list of values for the register.

jobId.description: ID of the PDF generation job, when submitting the form generates a PDF.

formDraftUrl.description: URL of the draft form in the application, based on the definition's formDraftUrlTemplate.

files.description: Form files as file-service URNs; only included when requested with includeData.

submission.description: submission for the form if form is submitted.

anonymousApply.description: Whether anonymous (unauthenticated) applicants can submit the form. Defaults to false.

scheduledIntakes.description: Allow this form definition to accept schedule intakes

queueTaskToProcess.description: Task queue that a task is created in for each submission. Not returned by the form APIs.
